excerpt.zh: 我们在[This.System.GetName]遇到的舰船似乎有点过时，但仍然武装到了牙齿。这些舰船应该是有人驾驶的，但对任何靠近的物体都展现了敌意。有必要谨慎应对……
excerpt.en: The vessels we encountered in the [This.System.GetName] system appear to be somewhat outmoded, but nevertheless armed to the teeth. They seem to be piloted by sentient crews but respond with hostility to any approach. We will have to treat them with caution.
